title: When the Harvest Falls
author: Wendell Coldharbour
blurb: Marguerite Quintana, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
